# v0.6.1 更新说明 / Release Notes

## 中文

- 发布本地纯净版：移除客户端埋点上报、远程统计服务、Analytics Dashboard 和远程公告服务。
- 客户端不再生成匿名统计 ID，也不再上报页面访问、功能使用或 AI 请求统计。
- 优化项目管理项目类型/项目分组下拉框，新增自定义选项后会立即出现在下拉列表中。
- 修复项目管理全套 Word 与单阶段 Word 导出封面分页问题，封面内容保持在同一页。
- 优化项目管理 Word 页码：封面无页码，目录使用大写罗马数字从 I 开始，正文使用阿拉伯数字从 1 开始。
- 优化项目管理 Word 目录样式，二级、三级、四级目录与一级目录左侧对齐，不再按层级缩进。
- 更新开发说明和隐私声明，使仓库规则与本地纯净版行为一致。

## English

- Released the local-only clean edition by removing client telemetry, remote analytics services, the Analytics Dashboard, and remote notice delivery.
- The client no longer creates anonymous analytics IDs or reports page views, feature usage, or AI request statistics.
- Improved project-management project type and project group dropdowns so newly added custom options appear immediately.
- Fixed project-management full-suite and single-stage Word exports so the cover content stays on the same page.
- Improved Word page numbering for project-management exports: no page number on the cover, uppercase Roman numerals starting from I for the table of contents, and decimal numbering starting from 1 for the body.
- Improved the project-management Word table of contents so level 2, 3, and 4 entries align with level 1 instead of being indented.
- Updated developer documentation and the privacy statement to match the local-only clean edition behavior.
